parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of incorrect ordering when using self-referencing foreign keys, but it may introduce unintended behavior.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of ordering when no explicit order_by is provided, which might affect existing queries that rely on the default ordering.
The patch introduces a minor maintainability issue by adding a conditional check that might not be immediately clear to future maintainers.
